messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into French, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE French line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Au milieu du chemin de notre vie je me suis retrouvé dans une forêt sombre, car la voie droite avait été perdue.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG] After the table, list any MISSING or WRONG items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Italian → French)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | **Nel** | “in the middle of” (locative prepositional phrase) | **Au** | “to the / at the” | OK | | **mezzo** | noun denoting the exact midpoint of a journey | **milieu** | “midst” | OK | | **del** | genitive “of the” linking *cammin* to *vita* | **du** | “of the” | OK | | **cammin** | “road, path” that constitutes the journey | **chemin** | “road” | OK | | **di** | preposition linking *nostra* to *vita* (possessive) | **de** | “of” | OK | | **nostra** | possessive adjective “our” (collective) | **notre** | “our” | OK | | **vita** | noun “life” (the span of existence) | **vie** | “life” | OK | | **mi** | reflexive pronoun, object of *ritrovai* | **me** | “myself” | OK | | **ritrovai** | “found (myself)” – past, self‑discovery event | **je me suis retrouvé** | “I found myself” | OK | | **per** | locative preposition “within/inside” | **dans** | “in/within” | OK | | **una** | indefinite article “a” (feminine) | **une** | “a” | OK | | **selva** | noun “forest, wood” | **forêt** | “forest” | OK | | **oscura** | adjective “dark” | **sombre** | “dark” | OK | | **ché** | causal conjunction “for” (resultative) | **car** | “for” | OK | | **la** | definite article “the” (feminine) | **la** | “the” | OK | | **diritta** | adjective “right, straight” (correct way) | **droite** | “right/straight” | OK | | **via** | noun “way, path” | **voie** | “way” | OK | | **era** | copular verb “had been” (imperfect) | **avait** | “had” (auxiliary) | OK | | **smarrita** | past participle “lost, missed” | **été perdue** | “been lost” | OK |
### Missing / Wrong Items *None – every source token has a corresponding French translation that respects the intended meaning and grammatical role.*

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING or WRONG items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Output per line: Line #, Original Translation, Issues, Corrected Translation (if any). Output final French text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

**Line # 1** - **Original Translation:** Au milieu du chemin de notre vie - **Issues:** none - **Corrected Translation:** Au milieu du chemin de notre vie
**Line # 2** - **Original Translation:** je me suis retrouvé dans une forêt sombre, - **Issues:** - The verb *ritrovai* was rendered as the multi‑word phrase “je me suis retrouvé”, which does not give a one‑to‑one correspondence with the source token. - This prevents a direct mapping of each Italian word to a French counterpart. - **Corrected Translation:** je me retrouvai dans une forêt sombre,
**Line # 3** - **Original Translation:** car la voie droite avait été perdue. - **Issues:** none - **Corrected Translation:** car la voie droite avait été perdue.
```text Au milieu du chemin de notre vie je me retrouvai dans une forêt sombre, car la voie droite avait été perdue. ```
